knowledge_state.purpose: exploratory mechanism tests; no reopening H1-H5

fixed_protocol.threshold: strictly below train q=0.01, fitted per seed/ablation
fixed_protocol.mask: eval_primary; unknown -> no alarm and positive unknown -> FN
fixed_protocol.metrics: same ml.metrics API; recall and FPR always together

content.note_on_plan_divergence: The original PHASE_6 plan expected recall to decrease after dropping d1. That prediction predates the measured tail inversion. A1 records the opposite mechanism-derived prediction without editing or hiding the original expectation.

A1_drop_delta.definition: IF on the 36 non-d1 frozen features, including agg.*; drop all 36 d1.* features
A1_drop_delta.mechanism: valid N-vary transitions own the registered lower tail; removing d1 should move q=0.01 upward and expose stable faults
A1_drop_delta.prediction_recall_q01: mean five-seed recall increases from 0.13% to >30%

A2_rolling_window3.definition: IF uses frozen raw+d1 plus causal ma3 features from load_split(use_rolling=True, window=3). Envelope replaces each of its 71 channels by its causal trailing-3 mean, refitting fold preprocessing, bounds, K and E on train only.
A2_rolling_window3.mechanism: smoothing should reduce normal transient peaks but also smooth fault onset and reduce coverage
A2_rolling_window3.prediction: IF recall increases; rolling-envelope FPR decreases; median detected delay of both increases by >=1 tick; coverage decreases by about 6%
A2_rolling_window3.refutation: delay does not increase for either detector

A3_raw_no_agg.definition: IF on 34 frozen non-d1, non-agg link/host features; drop d1.* and the two agg.rate_absz_* features
A3_raw_no_agg.why_separate_from_A1: A1 retains the only IF aggregate channels normalized by train link statistics; A3 isolates their contribution
A3_raw_no_agg.prediction: mean recall A3 is lower than A1
A3_raw_no_agg.refutation: mean recall A3 >= mean recall A1

A4_mask_sensitivity.result: envelope recall changes +1.9 to +2.6 points; excess FPR 5.35% -> 3.38%; dual FPR 0.47% -> 0%; control FPR remains 0%
A4_mask_sensitivity.conclusion: recall conclusion is robust; all-negative FPR depends on transition convention; control FPR is invariant

content.deviation_policy: do not edit this file; record implementation deviations and all refutations in phase6_ablations.json
